This review is an honest account of our experience, and I would hope it serves as insight to bring caution and awareness to what can happen at these low budget type of places.

We brought our miniature schnauzer here to get her spayed. I had seen many great reviews about the Spay Neuter Network, and my wife and I wanted to save money, so we decided to bring our dog here.

We got our dog checked in, and sometime later that day, I got a frantic and chilling call from the surgeon there. She explained they had to abort the procedure mid-surgery due to a “tube coming out of place” and causing aspiration because our dog started waking up mid surgery. She said she was extremely worried for our dog, and that she could potentially get aspiration induced pneumonia. The surgeon noted that they are “high volume” when describing the typical fast paced work flow; telling us they purposely use less anesthesia to make patients wake up faster and therefore have a quicker turnaround.

It is clear (just like with anything) that if there is a fast paced environment, mistakes, accidents, and carelessness are more prone to occur; and that is exactly what we experienced.

To top off this sad and tragic experience, the staff had the audacity to charge me a fee when I brought our dog back for a checkup.

Based on my experience, I highly recommend no one risk putting their dog in danger and to spend the extra money to take them to a private vet clinic to give their pet the time and attention they deserve.

We are anxiously looking after our dog in hopes she doesn’t develop pneumonia.
